Implementation Plan

Implementation plan: issue P1 (support code follows `promote-candidate`), orchestrator project #7745

This plans phase 1 only, which the project already split this way. Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-7745` @ `ac517d3d60c2236c7e3b64a1e5072b90a106fb1a` (Integration branch mismatch: false).

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends the existing "Resolve workflow support ref" steps and the `gh_api_retry` shim pattern of `review_autofix.yml`'s "Resolve trusted review support commit"
Scope-mode justification: The issue and the merged plan (`docs/plans/pin-promote-cycle-to-candidate-plan.md`, Phase 1, P1.1–P1.7) fix the scope: one new, exactly matched case per support-ref resolver in 13 reusable workflows, tests, and a changelog fragment. The plan goes past the issue text in two places, both kept to the minimum:
- It widens the seven downstream `WORKFLOW_REF` allowlists in `review_autofix.yml`. Without this, the review job's own identity checks reject `refs/heads/promote-candidate`.
- It adds the case to `validate.yml`'s "Fetch workflow support files". That step is where `validate.yml` actually stages its support scripts.

Leaving either out would ship a case that fails or does nothing once phase 2 runs (§6: correctness comes before speed). Nothing else changes: the gh-retry bootstraps of the other workflows, `sync_ai_labels.yml`, and the integration-ref resolvers outside `validate.yml` stay as they are.

## Functions or modules to implement

Automation & wiring (§20.E):
- Only existing workflow steps change, plus one new step in `memory_maintenance.yml`. No new script, no new schedule, no supervisor, no database work.
- No `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry is needed.
- The new code runs only when a caller uses `<file>.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate`. Phase 2 (a separate issue) switches the 13 `internal-*.yml` wrappers to that ref; until then the code is dormant.

### Shared shape (P1.1)
In every step whose name starts with "Resolve workflow support ref" in the nine P1.1 workflows, inside the existing `if [ "${{ github.repository }}" = "${wf_source}" ]` branch, replace the single `echo "SCRIPT_REF=${{ github.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"` with the block below. The consumer `else` branch is not touched.

```
promote_candidate_support_ref="${{ github.sha }}"
promote_candidate_workflow_ref="$(jq -r '.workflow_ref // ""' <<< "${SUPPORT_REF_WORKFLOW_JOB_JSON:-}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ "${promote_candidate_workflow_ref}" =~ ^shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/\.github/workflows/<THIS_FILE>\.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate$ ]]; then
  # One branches read, only on this path (§14: no earlier call in this step
  # returns the promote-candidate tip or its protection flag).
  source "${GH_API_RETRY_HELPERS:-/dev/null}" 2>/dev/null || true
  type gh_api_retry >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh_api_retry() { while [ "${1:-}" = --idempotent ] || [ "${1:-}" = --optional ]; do shift; done; gh api "$@"; }
  promote_candidate_json="$(gh_api_retry repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/promote-candidate 2>/dev/null || true)"
  promote_candidate_sha="$(jq -r 'if .protected == true then (.commit.sha // "") else "" end' <<< "${promote_candidate_json}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [[ "${promote_candidate_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
    promote_candidate_support_ref="${promote_candidate_sha}"
    echo "SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate sha=${promote_candidate_sha}"
  else
    echo "SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate_unprotected"
  fi
fi
echo "SCRIPT_REF=${promote_candidate_support_ref}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
```

- `<THIS_FILE>` is the workflow's own file name (escaped dot).
- In the duplicate-notice step of `implement.yml`, write `DUPLICATE_NOTICE_SCRIPT_REF`. In its CI-triage PR-not-open step (which compares against the literal repo name), write `PR_NOT_OPEN_SCRIPT_REF`.
- Each step gets `SUPPORT_REF_WORKFLOW_JOB_JSON: ${{ toJSON(job) }}` where it is missing; every listed step already has it.
- Each step also gets `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` added to its `env:` block. This value is only read on the new path.

Sites:
- `cancel_on_pr_close.yml`: the one step.
- `check_failure_triage.yml`: the one step.
- `clarify.yml`: both steps.
- `implement.yml`: all four ("for duplicate PR notice", "for CI-triage PR-not-open hand-off", and the two plain steps).
- `orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml`: the one step.
- `orchestrate_poll.yml`: both ("for gh retry", and the plain step).
- `orchestrate.yml`: both ("for run-start", and the plain step).
- `plan.yml`: both.
- `workflow_failure_heal.yml`: the one step.

The existing "Ensure workflow support source checkout" checks (and their equivalents) already require checkout HEAD to equal any 40-hex `SCRIPT_REF`. The `main`/fallback checkouts stay gated on `SCRIPT_REF == 'stable'`, so they cannot run on the new path.

### P1.2a `review_autofix.yml`, gate step "Resolve trusted review support commit" (`id: resolve_support`)
- Add `promote_candidate_ref='^shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/\.github/workflows/review_autofix\.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate$'`.
- The identity check needs no change: the exact ref already matches `source_branch_ref` for this repository.
- In the SHA-selection chain, insert a new arm before the final `else` (the protected-main read):
  - Condition: `[ "${CALLER_REPOSITORY}" = "shubhodeep1/coding-workflows" ] && [[ "${support_workflow_ref}" =~ ${promote_candidate_ref} ]]`.
  - It calls `gh_api_retry repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/promote-candidate`, guarded with `|| true` so a failed read is not fatal.
  - When the branch is protected and the SHA is 40 hex: set `support_sha` to the tip, `support_ref=refs/heads/promote-candidate`, and log `SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate sha=`.
  - Otherwise: log `SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate_unprotected` and run the unchanged protected-main body.
  - Shape: `if <exact case> && <protected tip resolved>; then …; else <existing main block>; fi`, keeping a single code path for main.
- The existing shim and the `source "${GH_API_RETRY_HELPERS}"` line are already at the top of the step.

### P1.2b `review_autofix.yml`, downstream allowlists
- Change all seven occurrences of `^(refs/heads/main|refs/tags/stable|[0-9a-f]{40})$` to `^(refs/heads/main|refs/heads/promote-candidate|refs/tags/stable|[0-9a-f]{40})$`.
- Occurrences: gate steps around lines 496, 538 and 585, and the steps in jobs `post-merge-validate-dispatch`, `post-merge-force-poll`, `fingerprint-cap-block`, and `codex-agent`'s "Resolve workflow support ref" (around lines 776, 999, 1547 and 2067).
- The value only ever comes from the gate output, which emits it only after the protected check.

### P1.2c `issue_pr_status.yml`, "Resolve trusted activation support commit" (`id: resolve_support`, actually around lines 1064-1112, not 925-950)
- Inside `if [ "${CALLER_REPOSITORY}" = "shubhodeep1/coding-workflows" ]`, add a first attempt: when `support_workflow_ref` matches `^shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/\.github/workflows/issue_pr_status\.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate$`, read the branches endpoint with plain `gh api … || true` (the file has no shim). On a protected 40-hex tip, set `support_sha` and log `source=promote_candidate`; otherwise log `source=promote_candidate_unprotected`.
- When no SHA was taken, run the existing protected-main block unchanged.
- This step emits only `support_sha` (it has no `support_ref` output), and that stays the same.

### P1.3 `validate.yml`
- **Bootstrap GitHub API retry helper** (around line 138). After `ghr_ref=main` for this repo, when `ghr_workflow_ref` matches the exact `validate\.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate` and plain `gh api …/branches/promote-candidate` (no helper exists yet at this point) reports a protected 40-hex tip, set `ghr_pin` and `ghr_ref` to that SHA. The existing pinned-fetch branch then fetches it and checks it equals FETCH_HEAD. Log as in the shared shape. The step stays `continue-on-error`.
- **Resolve integration ref.** Inside the existing `if [ "${{ github.repository }}" = "${resolver_repo}" ]` (which sets `resolver_ref="${{ github.sha }}"`), add the case: on a protected tip, `resolver_ref=<sha>` and `resolver_ref_pinned=true`, so a mismatched checkout fails closed instead of falling back to main. Use the sourced `gh_api_retry` or the shim. Add `GH_TOKEN` (already present).
- **Fetch workflow support files** (`helper_ref="main"` for this repo, around line 430). Add the same case: on a protected tip, `helper_ref=<sha>`. The existing 40-hex fetch-and-verify path is reused. `VALIDATE_SUPPORT_REF ref=` then reports the SHA.
- This third site is beyond the issue's literal "~138 and ~188-195". Without it, `validate.yml` support scripts would still come from `main` (see the conflict notes).

### P1.4 `memory_maintenance.yml`
Add one new first step, before "Checkout repository":
- Name `Resolve workflow support ref`, `id: promote_candidate_ref`.
- `env`: `SUPPORT_REF_WORKFLOW_JOB_JSON: ${{ toJSON(job) }}`, `GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}`, `CALLER_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}`.
- Body: only when `CALLER_REPOSITORY` is `shubhodeep1/coding-workflows` and the ref is exactly `memory_maintenance\.yml@refs/heads/promote-candidate`, read the branch with plain `gh api … || true`. Write `ref=<sha>` to `GITHUB_O
